"""A01-A07: closed public Windows admission, using real production owner seams.

These are inert Linux-host controls, not Windows/CAD/Blender qualification. Only
the host observations, RNA objects and explicitly forbidden side effects are
injected. Currentness, publication, request and receipt validation stay real.
Registration rejects Windows before any generated import, package/cache path or timer work.
"""

import ast
import importlib
import json
import os
import sys
import types
from dataclasses import replace
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from test_windows_runtime import (
    PACKAGE,
    ROOT,
    Fixture,
    contracts,
    digest,
    encode,
    jobs,
    launch,
    selection,
    w,
)
from test_windows_runtime import m as manifests

ADDON = ROOT / "blender_addon/mechanical_cad_blender"
runtime = importlib.import_module(PACKAGE + ".backend_runtime")
bridge = importlib.import_module(PACKAGE + ".bridge")
assembly_bridge = importlib.import_module(PACKAGE + ".assembly_bridge")
guarded = importlib.import_module(PACKAGE + ".guarded_evidence")
operations = importlib.import_module(PACKAGE + ".operation_contracts")
drafts = importlib.import_module(PACKAGE + ".sketch_draft")


def forbidden(events, name):
    def fail(*args, **kwargs):
        events.append(name)
        raise AssertionError("Forbidden public Windows side effect: " + name)

    return fail


class UnreadableEnvironment:
    def __init__(self, events):
        self.fail = forbidden(events, "environment")

    def keys(self):
        return self.fail()

    def __iter__(self):
        return self.fail()

    def __getitem__(self, key):
        return self.fail()


def closed_io(monkeypatch, *, platform="win32", os_name="nt"):
    """Module-local host facades never mutate global sys/platform/pathlib/os."""
    events = []
    host = types.SimpleNamespace(platform=platform)
    environment = UnreadableEnvironment(events)
    host_os = types.SimpleNamespace(
        name=os_name,
        environ=environment,
        path=types.SimpleNamespace(
            abspath=forbidden(events, "abspath"),
            normpath=forbidden(events, "normpath"),
            isabs=forbidden(events, "isabs"),
        ),
        access=forbidden(events, "access"),
    )
    for module in (selection, bridge, jobs):
        monkeypatch.setattr(module, "sys", host)
        monkeypatch.setattr(module, "os", host_os)
        monkeypatch.setattr(module, "Path", forbidden(events, module.__name__ + ".Path"))
    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "sys", host)
    monkeypatch.setattr(selection, "resolved_path", forbidden(events, "resolve"))
    monkeypatch.setattr(selection, "lexical_path", forbidden(events, "lexical"))
    monkeypatch.setattr(bridge, "resolve_configuration", forbidden(events, "configuration"))
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        bridge, "subprocess", types.SimpleNamespace(run=forbidden(events, "subprocess.run"))
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        jobs, "subprocess", types.SimpleNamespace(Popen=forbidden(events, "subprocess.Popen"))
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        jobs, "tempfile", types.SimpleNamespace(TemporaryFile=forbidden(events, "temporary file"))
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "BundlePreparationJob", forbidden(events, "preparation"))
    monkeypatch.setattr(w, "WindowsRuntimeAPI", forbidden(events, "Win32 runtime"))
    monkeypatch.setattr(w, "Win32API", forbidden(events, "Win32 process"))
    return events, environment


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def isolated_runtime(monkeypatch):
    values = dict(
        _LIFETIME="public-windows-negative",
        _GENERATION=0,
        _OBSERVED=None,
        _INVALIDATE=None,
        _BUNDLE_REQUIRED=False,
        _BUNDLE_ENABLED=False,
        _BUNDLE_JOB=None,
        _BUNDLE_JOB_REQUEST=None,
        _BUNDLE_REQUEST=None,
        _BUNDLE_POLICY=None,
        _BUNDLE_STATE="external",
        _BUNDLE_MESSAGE="external",
    )
    for name, value in values.items():
        monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, name, value)


def linux_policy():
    """An exact inert Linux policy, without creating or reading any runtime tree."""
    fixture = Fixture()
    bundle = manifests.bundle_identity("a" * 40, "b" * 64, "linux-x64")
    root = "/inert/cache/" + bundle
    release = json.loads(fixture.release)
    release.update(
        bundle_id=bundle,
        platform="linux-x64",
        manifest_path=f"_backend/{bundle}/bundle-manifest.json",
        payload_path=f"_backend/{bundle}/payload.zip",
    )
    release = encode(release)
    constants = dict(fixture.constants)
    constants.update(
        BUNDLE_ID=bundle,
        PLATFORM="linux-x64",
        PYTHON_PATH="python/bin/python3.12",
        RELEASE_IDENTITY_BYTES=release,
        RELEASE_IDENTITY_SHA256=digest(release),
    )
    descriptor = replace(
        fixture.descriptor,
        bundle_id=bundle,
        platform="linux-x64",
        root=root,
        python_path=root + "/python/bin/python3.12",
        bootstrap_path=root + "/bootstrap.py",
    )
    return launch.capture_bundled_policy(
        descriptor,
        package_root="/inert/package",
        cache_root="/inert/cache",
        release_data=release,
        constants=constants,
    )


@pytest.mark.parametrize("explicit_environment", [False, True])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("settings", [("", ""), (object(), object())])
def test_a01_public_capture_rejects_windows_before_any_io(
    monkeypatch, explicit_environment, settings
):
    events, environment = closed_io(monkeypatch)
    arguments = {"environment": environment} if explicit_environment else {}
    with pytest.raises(selection.SelectionError, match="Linux"):
        selection.BackendSelection.capture(
            *settings, generation=0, lifetime_id="public", **arguments
        )
    assert events == []


def test_a01_direct_nonbundled_selection_rejects_before_path_or_environment(monkeypatch):
    events, _ = closed_io(monkeypatch)
    with pytest.raises(selection.SelectionError, match="Linux"):
        selection.BackendSelection(
            "C:\\root", "C:\\python.exe", "C:\\python.exe", 5, 0, "direct", ()
        )
    assert events == []


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "platform,os_name,policy_kind",
    [
        ("win32", "nt", "windows"),
        ("win32", "nt", "linux"),
        ("win32", "nt", "invalid"),
        ("linux", "posix", "windows"),
        ("linux", "nt", "linux"),
    ],
)
def test_a02_public_bundle_capture_has_no_lower_fallback_or_io(
    monkeypatch, platform, os_name, policy_kind
):
    policy = {"windows": Fixture().policy, "linux": linux_policy, "invalid": object}[policy_kind]()
    events, _ = closed_io(monkeypatch, platform=platform, os_name=os_name)
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        selection.BackendSelection,
        "_capture_windows_bundled_transport",
        classmethod(forbidden(events, "qualification constructor")),
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        launch.BundledLaunchPolicy, "launch_environment", forbidden(events, "policy environment")
    )
    with pytest.raises(selection.SelectionError, match="Linux"):
        selection.BackendSelection.capture_bundled(policy, generation=0, lifetime_id="public")
    assert events == []


def context():
    preferences = types.SimpleNamespace(
        project_root="C:\\never-read",
        python_executable="C:\\never-run.exe",
        timeout_seconds=10.0,
        linear_deflection=0.1,
        enable_windows=True,
        windows_qualified=True,
    )
    document = dict(
        schema_version=2,
        id="part",
        name="Inert Part",
        units="mm",
        parameters={},
        features=[],
        active_feature=None,
    )
    state = types.SimpleNamespace(
        document_json=json.dumps(document),
        owner_id="owner",
        status="READY",
        sketch_draft_json="preserved draft",
        geometry_report_json="saved report",
        geometry_document_json=json.dumps(document),
        geometry_status="PASSED",
    )
    scene = types.SimpleNamespace(
        mechanical_cad=state,
        as_pointer=lambda: 173,
        unit_settings=types.SimpleNamespace(scale_length=1.0),
    )
    return types.SimpleNamespace(
        scene=scene,
        preferences=types.SimpleNamespace(
            addons={PACKAGE: types.SimpleNamespace(preferences=preferences)}
        ),
        window=object(),
        workspace=object(),
        view_layer=object(),
    )


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "platform,profile", [("win32", "windows"), ("win32", "linux"), ("linux", "windows")]
)
def test_a03_setup_rejects_without_preparation_and_revokes_before_callback(
    monkeypatch, platform, profile
):
    fixture = Fixture()
    policy = fixture.policy() if profile == "windows" else linux_policy()
    selected = fixture.selected()
    events, _ = closed_io(
        monkeypatch, platform=platform, os_name="nt" if platform == "win32" else "posix"
    )
    runtime._BUNDLE_POLICY, runtime._OBSERVED = policy, ("old evidence",)
    notifications = []
    runtime.configure_invalidation(
        lambda reason: notifications.append(
            (runtime._BUNDLE_POLICY, runtime._OBSERVED, runtime.stamp(), reason)
        )
    )
    assert not runtime.begin_bundled_setup(
        policy.package_root,
        policy.cache_root,
        {name: getattr(policy.constants, name) for name in launch.LAUNCH_CONSTANT_FIELDS},
    )
    assert runtime.bundle_status()[0] == "failed"
    assert "Windows" in runtime.bundle_status()[1]
    assert runtime._BUNDLE_REQUIRED and runtime._BUNDLE_POLICY is None
    assert runtime._BUNDLE_REQUEST is None and runtime._BUNDLE_JOB is None
    assert len(notifications) == 1 and notifications[0][:2] == (None, None)
    assert notifications[0][2] == ("public-windows-negative", 1)
    assert not runtime.is_current(selected, context())
    assert events == []


@pytest.mark.parametrize("platform,bundled", [("win32", False), ("win32", True), ("linux", True)])
def test_a03_configuration_and_currency_cannot_use_lower_windows_selection(
    monkeypatch, platform, bundled
):
    selected = Fixture().selected()
    ctx = context()
    events, _ = closed_io(
        monkeypatch, platform=platform, os_name="nt" if platform == "win32" else "posix"
    )
    runtime._BUNDLE_REQUIRED = runtime._BUNDLE_ENABLED = bundled
    runtime._BUNDLE_POLICY = selected.bundled_policy if bundled else None
    runtime._OBSERVED = ("previous valid evidence",)
    notices = []
    runtime.configure_invalidation(notices.append)
    for action in (
        lambda: runtime.configuration(ctx),
        lambda: runtime.capture(ctx),
        lambda: runtime.assert_current(selected, ctx),
    ):
        with pytest.raises(bridge.BridgeError, match="Linux"):
            action()
    assert not runtime.is_current(selected, ctx)
    assert runtime._OBSERVED is None and runtime._GENERATION == 1 and len(notices) == 1
    assert events == []


def extracted(filename, names, namespace, *, class_name=None):
    """Compile untouched production function ASTs; never imitate their decisions."""
    path = ADDON / filename
    tree = ast.parse(path.read_bytes(), filename=str(path))
    source = (
        tree.body
        if class_name is None
        else next(
            node.body
            for node in tree.body
            if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef) and node.name == class_name
        )
    )
    nodes = [node for node in source if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name in names]
    assert {node.name for node in nodes} == set(names)
    result = dict(namespace)
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=nodes, type_ignores=[]), str(path), "exec"), result)
    return result


def test_a04_registration_rejects_windows_before_any_setup_io(monkeypatch):
    side_effects, _ = closed_io(monkeypatch)
    source = ADDON / "registration.py"
    namespace = extracted(
        "registration.py",
        {"_start_bundle_setup", "_poll_bundle_setup"},
        dict(
            __package__="bl_ext.user_default.mechanical_cad",
            __file__=str(source),
            sys=types.SimpleNamespace(platform="win32"),
            Path=forbidden(side_effects, "package path"),
            backend_runtime=runtime,
            LAUNCH_CONSTANT_FIELDS=launch.LAUNCH_CONSTANT_FIELDS,
            importlib=types.SimpleNamespace(
                import_module=forbidden(side_effects, "generated module import")
            ),
            bpy=types.SimpleNamespace(
                utils=types.SimpleNamespace(
                    extension_path_user=forbidden(side_effects, "extension cache")
                ),
                app=types.SimpleNamespace(
                    timers=types.SimpleNamespace(
                        is_registered=forbidden(side_effects, "timer query"),
                        register=forbidden(side_effects, "timer registration"),
                    )
                ),
            ),
        ),
    )
    namespace["_start_bundle_setup"]()
    assert runtime.bundle_status()[0] == "failed"
    assert "pending native qualification" in runtime.bundle_status()[1]
    assert runtime._BUNDLE_JOB is None and runtime._BUNDLE_POLICY is None
    assert side_effects == []


def fabricated_completion(prepared, selected, owner):
    """Attack input: exact class and success bit, but no valid backend receipt."""
    evidence = object.__new__(guarded.GuardedEvidence)
    for name, value in dict(
        _prepared=prepared,
        _response_payload=b'{"protocol_version":1,"ok":true}',
        _projection_payload=b"{}",
        selection=selected,
        _owner_token=owner,
    ).items():
        object.__setattr__(evidence, name, value)
    object.__setattr__(evidence, "_publication", guarded.EvidencePublication(evidence))
    return evidence


def part_namespace():
    return extracted(
        "document_state.py",
        {
            "_result_version",
            "_scene_key",
            "_read_document",
            "_runtime_record",
            "part_is_current",
            "geometry_report_is_current",
            "current_part_evidence",
            "current_part_result",
            "_evidence_projection",
            "_assert_binding",
            "_capture_binding",
            "_publish_candidate_locked",
        },
        dict(
            bridge=bridge,
            backend_runtime=runtime,
            backend_contracts=contracts,
            GuardedEvidence=guarded.GuardedEvidence,
            operation_contracts=operations,
            json=json,
            _PART_ACTIONS={"replay", "check_geometry", "export_step", "export_stl"},
            _RUNTIME={},
            _GEOMETRY_RUNTIME={},
            _REPLAY_RUNNING=True,
        ),
    )


def test_a04_real_part_read_and_publication_reject_lower_selection_and_fabricated_completion(
    monkeypatch,
):
    selected, ctx, owner = Fixture().selected(), context(), object()
    namespace = part_namespace()
    document = json.loads(ctx.scene.mechanical_cad.document_json)
    prepared = contracts.prepare_request(
        dict(
            protocol_version=1,
            action="replay",
            result_version=2,
            document=document,
            options={"linear_deflection": 0.1},
        )
    )
    evidence = fabricated_completion(prepared, selected, owner)
    binding = dict(
        scene=ctx.scene,
        owner_id="owner",
        document_json=json.dumps(document),
        scale=1.0,
        selection=selected,
        owner_token=owner,
        deflection=0.1,
        prepared=prepared,
        request_fingerprint=prepared.fingerprint,
        result_version=2,
        evidence=evidence,
    )
    namespace["_RUNTIME"][173] = binding
    namespace["_GEOMETRY_RUNTIME"][173] = binding
    events, _ = closed_io(monkeypatch)
    namespace["_preflight_owned_display"] = forbidden(events, "Part display staging")
    before = vars(ctx.scene.mechanical_cad).copy()
    for name in ("part_is_current", "geometry_report_is_current"):
        assert namespace[name](ctx) is False
    for name in ("current_part_result", "current_part_evidence"):
        assert namespace[name](ctx) is None
    for action in (
        lambda: namespace["_capture_binding"](ctx, selection=selected),
        lambda: namespace["_evidence_projection"](ctx, document, evidence, binding, consume=True),
        lambda: namespace["_publish_candidate_locked"](
            ctx, document, evidence, binding, json.dumps(document)
        ),
    ):
        with pytest.raises(bridge.BridgeError, match="Linux"):
            action()
    assert evidence.publication._state == "available"
    assert vars(ctx.scene.mechanical_cad) == before and events == []


def sketch_namespace(ctx):
    methods = extracted(
        "viewport_sketch.py",
        {
            "_assert_owner",
            "evidence_is_current",
            "current_solver_report",
            "has_current_solution",
            "initialize_preview",
        },
        dict(
            backend_runtime=runtime,
            bpy=types.SimpleNamespace(context=ctx),
            DraftError=drafts.DraftError,
            document_state=types.SimpleNamespace(**part_namespace()),
        ),
        class_name="RectangleSession",
    )
    names = {
        "_assert_owner",
        "evidence_is_current",
        "current_solver_report",
        "has_current_solution",
        "initialize_preview",
    }
    cls = type("ExtractedRectangleSession", (), {name: methods[name] for name in names})
    session = cls()
    session.alive, session.scene, session.window, session.workspace = (
        True,
        ctx.scene,
        ctx.window,
        ctx.workspace,
    )
    session.stored_snapshot = ctx.scene.mechanical_cad.sketch_draft_json
    session.valid_context = lambda: True  # UI-context leaf only.
    session.draft = drafts.RectangleDraft(ctx.scene.mechanical_cad.document_json)
    session.draft.phase = "DIMENSIONS"
    session.draft.seed_bounds = (0, 0), 2, 3
    session.draft.fixed_target = (0, 0)
    session.draft.width_text, session.draft.height_text = "2", "3"
    return session


def test_a04_real_sketch_preview_and_acceptance_never_gain_windows_authority(monkeypatch):
    ctx, selected, owner = context(), Fixture().selected(), object()
    session = sketch_namespace(ctx)
    candidate = session.draft.candidate()
    prepared = contracts.prepare_request(
        dict(
            protocol_version=1,
            action="replay",
            result_version=2,
            document=candidate,
        )
    )
    evidence = fabricated_completion(prepared, selected, owner)
    events, _ = closed_io(monkeypatch)
    # An exact-class fabricated completion fails the unmodified receipt validator
    # even when a lower transport selection is supplied directly to the draft.
    with pytest.raises(contracts.BackendContractError):
        session.draft.accept_guarded_replay(
            candidate, evidence, selected, owner_token=owner, consume=True
        )
    assert session.draft._guarded_evidence is None and not session.draft.validated_json
    session.draft._guarded_evidence = evidence
    session.draft._guarded_owner = owner
    session.draft._guarded_candidate = json.dumps(candidate, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)
    session.draft.validated_json = json.dumps(candidate)
    assert session.evidence_is_current is False
    assert session.current_solver_report() is None and not session.has_current_solution
    assert session.draft._guarded_evidence is None and not session.draft.validated_json
    assert evidence.publication._state == "available" and events == []

            "_configuration",
            "_current_selection",
            "_assert_current",
            "_preflight_assembly",

            "_publish_report",

            "report_is_current",
            "_binding",
        },
        dict(
            bridge=bridge,
            backend_runtime=runtime,
            backend_contracts=contracts,
            guarded_evidence=guarded,
            assembly_bridge=assembly_bridge,
            assembly_display=types.SimpleNamespace(**display),
            operation_contracts=operations,
            SimpleNamespace=types.SimpleNamespace,
            _RUNTIME={},
            _EPOCHS={},
        ),
    )


def test_a04_real_assembly_read_and_publication_reject_lower_selection_and_fabrication(monkeypatch):
    ctx, selected, owner = context(), Fixture().selected(), object()
    namespace = assembly_namespace()
    assembly = {"kind": "assembly", "assembly_schema_version": 1, "part_sources": []}
    prepared = contracts.prepare_request(
        assembly_bridge.build_request(assembly, "assembly_check", result_version=2)
    )
    evidence = fabricated_completion(prepared, selected, owner)
    state = types.SimpleNamespace(
        owner_id="assembly-owner",
        document_json=json.dumps(assembly),
        display_status="CURRENT",
        verification_status="CURRENT",
    )
    ctx.scene.mechanical_cad_assembly = state
    snapshot = dict(selection=selected, prepared=prepared, owner_token=owner)
    namespace["_RUNTIME"][173] = dict(
        owner_id=state.owner_id,
        display_document_json=state.document_json,
        display_evidence=evidence,
        display_owner_token=owner,
    )
    transaction = dict(state=state, snapshot=snapshot, wrote_state=False)
    events, _ = closed_io(monkeypatch)
    namespace["_write_fields"] = forbidden(events, "Assembly publication")
    before = vars(state).copy()
    assert not namespace["display_is_current"](ctx)
    assert not namespace["report_is_current"](ctx)
    for action in (
        lambda: namespace["_current_selection"](ctx, snapshot),
        lambda: namespace["_configuration"](ctx),
        lambda: namespace["_projection"](
            ctx, snapshot, evidence, actions={"assembly_check"}, consume=True
        ),
        lambda: namespace["_publish_report"](ctx, transaction, evidence),
    ):
        with pytest.raises(bridge.BridgeError, match="Linux"):
            action()
    assert vars(state) == before and not transaction["wrote_state"]
    assert evidence.publication._state == "available" and events == []


@pytest.mark.parametrize("platform,os_name", [("win32", "nt"), ("win32", "posix"), ("linux", "nt")])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("entry", ["raw", "replay", "geometry", "assembly", "job"])
def test_a05_raw_public_entries_reject_before_configuration_environment_or_launch(
    monkeypatch, platform, os_name, entry
):
    events, _ = closed_io(monkeypatch, platform=platform, os_name=os_name)
    calls = dict(
        raw=lambda: bridge._exchange_raw({}, project_root="", python_executable="", timeout=10),
        replay=lambda: bridge.replay({}),
        geometry=lambda: bridge.geometry_action({}, "check_geometry"),
        assembly=lambda: assembly_bridge.assembly_action({}),
        job=lambda: jobs.SidecarJob({}),
    )
    with pytest.raises(bridge.BridgeError, match="Windows.*not yet qualified"):
        calls[entry]()
    assert events == []


def test_a06_qualification_constructor_has_exactly_one_definition_and_no_production_reference():
    target = "_capture_windows_bundled_transport"
    definitions, references = [], []
    paths = sorted(
        path for root in (ADDON, ROOT / "src", ROOT / "scripts") for path in root.rglob("*.py")
    )
    for path in paths:
        tree = ast.parse(path.read_bytes(), filename=str(path))
        for node in ast.walk(tree):
            if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and node.name == target:
                definitions.append(path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix())
            if (
                (isinstance(node, ast.Attribute) and node.attr == target)
                or (isinstance(node, ast.Name) and node.id == target)
                or (isinstance(node, ast.alias) and node.name == target)
                or (isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and node.value == target)
            ):
                references.append((path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(), node.lineno))
    assert definitions == ["blender_addon/mechanical_cad_blender/backend_selection.py"]
    assert references == []


def test_a07_linux_public_selection_still_captures_the_exact_external_and_bundled_profiles():
    selected = selection.BackendSelection.capture(
        str(ROOT), sys.executable, generation=3, lifetime_id="linux-control", environment={}
    )
    assert selected.project_root == str(ROOT)
    assert selected.python_executable == os.path.abspath(sys.executable)
    assert selected.launch_environment() == {
        "PYTHONPATH": str(ROOT / "src"),
        "PYTHONNOUSERSITE": "1",
        "PYTHONIOENCODING": "utf-8",
    }
    policy = linux_policy()
    bundled = selection.BackendSelection.capture_bundled(
        policy, generation=3, lifetime_id="linux-control"
    )
    assert bundled.bundled_policy is policy and bundled.project_root == policy.descriptor.root
    assert bundled.launch_environment() == policy.launch_environment()
    assert bundled.core_origin == str(Path(policy.descriptor.root) / "src/mechanical_cad")
